description: This is a PHPUnit test class `CustomLoaderTest` that contains unit tests for the `CustomLoader` class functions such as `arrayMerge`, `mergeCustomArray`, and `loadCustomRoutes`. It also includes setup and assertions to verify correct behavior of custom array merging and route loading in the context of SuiteCRM.

classes.name: CustomLoaderTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests methods of the CustomLoader class related to array merging and route loading within SuiteCRM's PHP codebase.

methods.name: testArrayMerge
methods.description: Tests the `arrayMerge` method of `CustomLoader` to ensure it correctly merges and concatenates array elements.

methods.name: testMergeCustomArray
methods.description: Tests the `mergeCustomArray` method of `CustomLoader` for proper file inclusion, error handling, and exception throwing on incorrect formats.

methods.name: testLoadCustomRoutes
methods.description: Tests the `loadCustomRoutes` method of `CustomLoader` to verify route loading and error handling when route files are missing or present.
